description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Rear Oil Seal Repair Kit that repairs leaking seals in the rear axle.
Does BOTH SIDES.
Note: To keep cost down we don’t sell you parts that are typically good to reuse (ie. metal washer, bolts etc¦)
This set is OEM SGP Japan with exception of retainer rings, which are not SGP Japan stock as imaged.
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Bearing Retainer Ring 43485M73000
Qty 2 – Oil Seal / Rear Axle 09283-48007
Qty 2 – Oil Seal Protector 43588-73000
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Geo Tracker 1989 – 1999
Suzuki Sidekick 1989 – 1998
Suzuki Samurai 1985-1995
